description.value: Kimshaker Resto is a Filipino restaurant on Kingsway, one of Burnaby's main commercial corridors and a well-travelled urban cycling route connecting Vancouver and the eastern suburbs. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a flexible stop for cyclists regardless of weather. Its location on a busy high-street strip puts it within easy reach of amenities and transit for touring cyclists moving through Metro Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only Instagram's generic login and navigation pages — no business-specific content was accessible without authentication, so all amenity fields rely on OSM tags alone. OSM has a recent check_date of 2026-03-25 and looks_closed=false, supporting confirmed_open=true. OSM tags confirm outdoor_seating=yes and indoor_seating=yes but provide no evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities.
concerns: Website fetch returned only Instagram's generic login/navigation pages — no business-specific content was accessible without authentication. All amenity fields are unverifiable from the website.

OSM contact:instagram tag points to https://kimshakerresto.zomi.menu/ (a Zomi online ordering page) while the discovered URL used for fetching is https://www.instagram.com/kimshaker.resto/ — these are two different URLs; the Zomi ordering link may be the more useful web presence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Filipino restaurant on a major Burnaby commercial street with a recent OSM check date; a useful food stop for touring cyclists on the Kingsway corridor.
